outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge on clinical application of interventional options relevant to vascular and interventional radiology.
Build practical skills and techniques required to accurately code interventional radiology procedures.
Examine various disease processes in terms of epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical manifestations, treatment alternatives and expected outcome/prognosis in IR specialty services.
Adhere to principles of medical ethics by respecting and protecting patients’ best interest and being altruistic and accountable.

Demonstrate an awareness of and responsiveness to the larger context and system of health care, as well as the ability to call effectively on other resources in the system to provide optimal health care.
